latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* EPS import: charge scanned strings, end failed filter decodes, bound data sources and JPEG/TIFF headers by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6627
* i18n(ka): update the Georgian catalog (55 strings) by @devius in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6630
* Guides: ruler guides are document objects on their layers by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6632
* Commands: every angle and rotation param says which way it turns (#6340) by @Hassan1305 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6631
* Scripts: File and Folder read files in the script's own folder by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6615
* JavaScript: new XML copies a one-item list's node, and insertChildAfter and insertChildBefore take fuel per child scanned by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6626
* G5: built-in Energy Beams brush library by @Messhias in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6603
* Script checker: names follow Unicode ID_Start and ID_Continue by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6641
* Commands: ids null acts on the selection instead of being refused by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6640
* Tests: plug-in folder tests take turns on the folder last loaded by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6636
* Part of #6622: Help Bar hints and tool names show in full on hover when clipped by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6639
* PDF: an option writes pages longer than 200 in at full size in points by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6643
* Scripts: Math.random gets a new seed on every web page load by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6645
* Plug-ins: the fuzz test reads the runtime's fuel slice instead of a copy by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6646
* Type: Dynamic Text sizes type on a path to fill its brackets by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6648
* Scripts: an uncaught error that passes through a finally block is reported where it was thrown by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6653
* Scripts: test that the OS random value seeds Math.random by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6657
* Simplify: a closed subpath whose refits enclose no area keeps its outline by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6651
* ci: use StepSecurity's maintained actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6658
* SVG import: references follow an id's first element, one read per linked file, bounded blank lines by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5409
* CI: nightly release dry run by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6678
* Graphs: graph.setType, setData and create refuse params of the wrong type by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6735
* Paragraph Styles: Style Options edits indents, spacing, composition, hyphenation and justification by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6734
* Symbols: the panel menu sorts by name and offers Small and Large List views by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6733
* Plug-ins: a failed rename back of a removed plug-in's settings is reported and undone later by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6732
* Edit: Paste in Place, in Front and in Back put a copy on each selected artboard by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6743
* Control bar: the panel menu turns each group of options on or off by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/6737
* .ai/EPS import: gradient mesh corners in several inks take their tints last ink first by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/story

VectorCraft

Vector illustration; an open-source, modern vector art application, built in pure Rust.

A fast, open-source vector illustration workflow. It runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and FreeBSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly. Built by the ArtCraft team.


VectorCraft on getartcraft.com · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps



Neon Drive: a Pathfinder-cut sun, live Outer Glow on the type and grid, and clipping masks · examples/neon-drive.vectorcraft

> [!NOTE] > **ArtCraft is a community of artists from all walks of life.** Digital, generative, music, > games — if you make things, you're one of us. **[Come say hi on Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft).**

A look around · Made in VectorCraft · Why VectorCraft · Quick start · Status · Downloads · The Crafting Apps · License

## A look around

Live Blends and Layers: editable key paths, smooth colour, every object a row

Pen and Direct Selection: real Bézier anchors and handles, plus a contextual task bar

3D Revolve: smooth vector shading, caps and a rotation gizmo · examples/still-life.vectorcraft

Dimension tool: lengths, angles and radii that follow the art they measure · examples/bracket-drawing.vectorcraft

Perspective Grid: art attached to its planes stays editable in perspective · examples/perspective-city.vectorcraft

Multiple artboards, light theme: Pathfinder · Gradient Mesh · live radial Repeat · Envelope Distort · examples/feature-sheet.vectorcraft
## Made in VectorCraft Every piece below was built entirely through VectorCraft's command API, the same one the MCP server exposes to agents, and exported by VectorCraft's own renderer. The source files are in [`examples/`](examples).

Neon Drive: synthwave poster with glowing type and grid

Dusk: gradient sky, glowing sun, layered mountains

Live Blends: 70 steps, smooth colour, editable spines

Still Life: four revolved profiles with smooth vector shading

Radial Repeat: a live mandala

Envelope Distort: striped type warped into a flag

Gradient Mesh: shaded spheres

Pathfinder: a crescent and stars from exact booleans
## Why VectorCraft - **Familiar.** A familiar layout, tools, menus, panels and shortcuts: the Pen, Direct Selection, Pathfinder, Smart Guides, Appearance, Swatches, Layers and more. You already know how to use it. - **Fast.** Multithreaded SIMD rendering off the UI thread. 20,000 shapes render in about 27 ms at full retina resolution while the interface stays at 120 fps. - **Robust.** Exact curve booleans (no "cannot perform operation"), unlimited undo via structural sharing, and property-tested file round trips. - **Open.** A documented native format (`.vectorcraft`, JSON), first-class SVG, PDF (and PDF-compatible `.ai`) import and export, PNG/JPEG/WebP export, Export for Screens, and SVGZ, templates, GIF, TIFF and BMP on open. - **Agent-native.** Every menu item, tool gesture, panel and dialog can be driven over a JSON control channel and an **MCP server**, so Claude and other agents can draw, edit and export the way a person does. - **Everywhere.** One codebase for the desktop apps and the same UI in the browser. ## Quick start For posters and sewing patterns, see [Print a large poster across multiple pages](docs/print-tiling.md). ```sh git clone https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft cd vectorcraft cargo run --release -p vectorcraft # desktop app cargo run --release -p vectorcraft -- examples/dusk-poster.vectorcraft cargo run --release -p vectorcraft -- --control 7979 # + JSON control channel cargo run --release -p vectorcraft-cli -- mcp # MCP server (stdio) cargo run --release -p vectorcraft-cli -- run --in examples/ribbons.vectorcraft --export out.pdf # headless batch cargo run --release -p vectorcraft-cli -- bench examples/neon-drive.vectorcraft # render timing cargo xtask bundle # dist/VectorCraft.app (macOS) cd apps/vectorcraft-web && trunk build --release # web build → dist/web cargo xtask ci # fmt, clippy, tests, layering, wasm, vendor names ``` For text and custom letter shapes, see [Typography and Custom Lettering](docs/typography-lettering.md). Japanese fonts come from [storytold/craft-fonts](https://github.com/storytold/craft-fonts), an optional build input (releases always use it): `CRAFT_FONTS_DIR="$PWD/../craft-fonts" cargo run --release -p vectorcraft` (an absolute path). Without it, Japanese text uses the installed system fonts. See [`docs/development.md`](docs/development.md#fonts-craft-fonts-optional-build-input). On machines with two graphics processors, VectorCraft renders on the power-saving (integrated) one by default on Windows and macOS, and on the one the desktop runs on under Linux. To choose, use **Preferences › Performance › Graphics Processor** and restart. If a graphics processor can't show the window, VectorCraft starts again on the next one. To pick one when starting the app, set `WGPU_POWER_PREF=high` (or `low`), or `WGPU_ADAPTER_NAME` to part of its name, such as `WGPU_ADAPTER_NAME=nvidia` (see [`docs/development.md`](docs/development.md#desktop-graphics-processor)). On native Wayland, winit 0.30 does not deliver dropped files. To open an SVG, use File › Open; to place artwork in the current document, copy and paste the file in a file manager. For file drag-and-drop, set **Preferences › Performance › Linux Display Server** to **X11 (XWayland)** and restart, or start the app with `WAYLAND_DISPLAY= vectorcraft`: the window then opens through XWayland, where drops work (see [`docs/development.md`](docs/development.md#linux-wayland-and-x11)). On Linux with Wayland, under KDE Plasma 6.3 or later and under GNOME, VectorCraft can't get a drawing tablet's pen input on native Wayland yet (#491, #2028). When a pen is attached as VectorCraft starts, the window opens through XWayland, where the pen works as a mouse and the app reads its pressure (#4967; `VECTORCRAFT_NATIVE_WAYLAND=1` keeps Wayland). For a pen attached later, set the same preference to **X11 (XWayland)** and restart, or start the app with `WAYLAND_DISPLAY= vectorcraft` (see [`docs/development.md`](docs/development.md#linux-wayland-and-x11)). ### Use it from Claude Code and other agents Register the MCP server with Claude Code: ```sh claude mcp add vectorcraft -- /path/to/vectorcraft-cli mcp ``` To keep an agent to one project's files, give it folders to read and write (the same flags as PhotoCraft): ```sh claude mcp add vectorcraft -- /path/to/vectorcraft-cli mcp --automation-read-root /work/project --automation-write-root /work/project ``` The details are in [`docs/mcp.md`](docs/mcp.md) and [`docs/control-protocol.md`](docs/control-protocol.md). ## Status VectorCraft is under active development. [**ROADMAP.md**](ROADMAP.md) has the stage, the numbers by dimension and what's next; [`docs/target-app-parity.md`](docs/target-app-parity.md) the full parity assessment and [`docs/gaps.md`](docs/gaps.md) the ranked list of what's missing. **Where we are (2026-10-10): alpha.** About 88% of core menu items, tools, effects and formats exist (92.5% of menu items do something), feature depth is ~75%, and we estimate ~65% ready for real work for a mainstream illustrator (~62% across all tracked features): everyday vector illustration is close to usable: drawing and path tools, Pathfinder and Shape Builder, paint, gradients, appearance and transparency, type with styles, threading and Hebrew/Arabic bidirectional layout, and files (SVG, PDF and PDF-compatible `.ai` with PDF/X, legacy version 7 `.ai` keeping layers, groups and type, EPS, DXF, EMF/WMF, raster formats, PSD out, PSD/PSB opened with their layers and placed as their merged image, JPEG XL in, Print, Package). Affinity documents (`.af` from Affinity 3, `.afdesign`, `.afpub` and, by their content, `.afphoto` from Affinity 1 and 2) open and place natively: layers, groups, artboards and pages, curves and shapes, fills, gradients and strokes, clipping and masks, text with each paragraph's indents, spacing and leading, tables (as text frames and lines), master pages, shadows, glows, outlines and overlays, embedded Affinity documents and images, with what didn't come in (adjustments, blurs, bevels, brushes…) listed in the import warning; a file whose native data can't be read opens as its embedded preview, saying why. VectorCraft doesn't write Affinity files. Current `.af` validation includes 33 pinned files, native save/reload and every-board SVG/PDF/PSD export, with fixes for Affinity 3 artboards, source-backed JPEGs and text runs. [Scope and limits](crates/affinity/README.md); [source audit and remaining gaps](docs/affinity-validation.md). The interface speaks English, German, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Swedish, Ukrainian, Finnish, Bulgarian, Greek, Czech, Georgian and Catalan; [localization-parity.md](docs/localization-parity.md) has the details. The scores are self-assessed from our code against public documentation; [target-app-parity.md](docs/target-app-parity.md#how-this-was-measured-2026-10-10) explains how far to trust them. **What's missing:** - reliable exchange of .ai files (layer structure in real files; the editing copy a save writes keeps live effects only on paths, compound paths and groups that qualify (at most a fill and a stroke, a non-zero fill rule when filled, no large canvas) and whose appearance and effects the art-style writer supports (see [docs/file-format-parity.md](docs/file-format-parity.md)), leaves out other objects' effects other than geometry effects, and writes live objects as their art); - an interaction-fidelity pass covering every tool's modifiers and small behaviours; - 3D and Materials beyond the initial live Revolve (Extrude & Bevel, Inflate, Rotate, materials); - filter thumbnails and a preview area inside the Effect Gallery (the gallery itself and all 57 Photoshop-style raster filters, approximated, are in); - CJK composition for vertical type (vertical type itself has initial support, with a Japanese interface); - scripting, and the rest of Variables (image and graph kinds, dataset import); - generative AI features. **Where we're going:** next is the interaction-fidelity pass, `.ai` files from real users and start-up stability, alongside the raster-effects package; then type, recent additions and 3D. The ranked list is in [`docs/gaps.md`](docs/gaps.md). **Workspace:** `crates/{geom, color, doc, pathops, text, effects, three-d, trace, brush, render, svg, pdf, eps, cad, metafile, format, tools, engine, ui-egui, mcp, testkit}` and `apps/{vectorcraft, vectorcraft-cli, vectorcraft-web}`. The egui frontend is its own crate, so the UI can be swapped without touching the engine. Agent and contributor rules (clean-room, the asset policy, no panics in shipped code, quality gates) are in [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md); [`docs/development.md`](docs/development.md#robustness-vectorcraft-never-crashes) explains how VectorCraft avoids crashing, and [`docs/releasing.md`](docs/releasing.md) how releases are built, signed and published. Every bundled asset is listed with its licence in [`ASSETS.md`](ASSETS.md). ## Downloads **New to VectorCraft?** Download it from the [VectorCraft page on getartcraft.com](https://getartcraft.com/apps/vectorcraft). That's the easiest way to install it. **Want a specific build or format?** On GitHub, the [latest release](https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/releases/latest) has every build listed below, and [all releases](https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/releases) has earlier versions and their notes. `` in the file names is the version number, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists a checksum for every
